description: The source reports monitoring-visit results for continuing-care homes and supportive-living accommodation. Its description includes accommodation standards for building maintenance, security, housekeeping and meals, and health-service standards for relevant care homes. Two XLSX descriptors identify the compliance report as of 25 August 2025 and its column descriptions. These are inspections of healthcare accommodation and its service conditions. Exact compliance scores, individual facility fields and monitoring coverage remain unstated. The record describes a dated inspection release, without asserting that every facility complies or that its status remains unchanged. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
